picks.editorial_note: Purdue landing two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards signals the federal government's flagship AI-for-science initiative is now flowing to campus labs, with direct implications for major-facility data infrastructure like the Electron-Ion Collider.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub led by Cambridge fuses stem-cell tissue models with AI to accelerate drug development — a substantial, well-funded bet on AI reshaping preclinical medicine.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: An ARPA-H-backed collaboration between SRI, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Florida to build AI-guided medical procedure assistance shows federal health-innovation funding and cross-institutional partnership converging on a concrete clinical tool.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama's Fermilab partnership under the DOE Genesis Mission applies AI to sift massive particle-physics datasets, pairing national-lab infrastructure with academic research at real scale.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's Genesis Mission Phase I funding targets AI for quantum error correction and national-lab resource sharing, extending the DOE's new AI-for-science push to another major research campus.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: A $12 million Army Research Laboratory grant to Penn State for animal-inspired AI sensing in autonomous drones and robots is a significant defense-funded bet on next-generation battlefield-relevant AI hardware.
picks.title: $12M grant to build animal-inspired sensing for autonomous drones and robots | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: HKU's RoboDojo, built with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes the first unified benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability — the kind of standard-setting work that shapes an entire research subfield.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's Jason Zhang using generative AI to design novel proteins never seen in nature, building on Nobel laureate David Baker's techniques, represents a genuine frontier advance in AI-driven molecular design.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial tumor proteomics offers a new AI approach to predicting cancer treatment response, with direct potential clinical relevance.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: Hebrew University's Haim Sompolinsky winning the 2026 Dirac Medal recognizes foundational statistical-mechanics theory underpinning modern AI — a top-tier honor validating deep theoretical contributions to the field.
picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal
